data.one_liner: Heuristic device integrity signals for root, jailbreak, emulator, Frida, and debugger detection.
data.what_it_does: Provides multi-signal device integrity reports for Android and iOS using native Kotlin/C++ and Swift/Objective-C++. Detects compromised states such as root, jailbreak, emulators, hooking frameworks like Frida, and attached debuggers without third-party SDKs.
use_when: You need to detect root or jailbreak status before allowing sensitive actions in your app.
You want to identify emulators, debuggers, or hooking frameworks like Frida on Android and iOS.
You want native device integrity checks without relying on heavy third-party SDKs.
avoid_when: You require 100% foolproof tamper resistance, as heuristic checks can be bypassed by advanced cloaking tools.
Your project targets operating systems other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Fast execution targeting 1 to 20 milliseconds total time.
Pure platform code with no external third-party SDK dependencies.
Supports both CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager on iOS.
weaknesses: Relies on heuristics which can be bypassed by advanced root-cloaking or stealth tools.
Requires manual platform-specific configuration like application query schemes on iOS for full functionality.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. For iOS jailbreak path checks, add application query schemes (such as cydia and sileo) to Info.plist under LSApplicationQueriesSchemes.
